Name: Safe Crab Pots
Author: Markentyy
Description:
[center][b]Safe Crab Pots[/b][/center]

Stop losing crab pots to misclicks.

Vanilla picks the pot up when you right-click an empty unbaited one, so every harvest run risks pocketing pots instead of checking them. Luremaster players have it worst, since their pots never hold bait.

[center][b]Features[/b][/center]
- Right-click harvests; holding bait also rebaits in the same click (if you have Luremaster, rebait will not happen).
- Empty pots are retrieved only with modifier + right-click (key configurable, default LeftShift); otherwise a hint is shown.
- Three toggles (pickup mode, retrieve key, auto-rebait) via GMCM or config.json. Gamepad buttons can be assigned as the modifier.

Compatibility: works next to catch-math mods like Better Crab Pot (different code paths). Full overhauls with auto-harvest such as Custom Crab Pot isn't - so pick one.

Requirements: Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.x. No save changes, safe to add or remove at any time.

Downloads.Description: Nexus update key so SMAPI notifies players about new versions.
